note: The game's own peoples (the owner, 2026-10-03: "maybe we dont use those races and we make custom ones for our full metal alchemist and edge chronicles sky pirates treasure planet game", then "yea lets test it"; docs/peoples_world.md). A TEST: the character creator lists these instead of the 35 real peoples (CharacterPeoples.listed_peoples; the user arg peoples=real lists the old ones). The real peoples stay in assets/character/body/peoples.json, and every face of theirs is a face of every people here: no invented people maps onto one real ancestry. Each people sets its skin range, eye and hair colours (eye_colors adds the ones the body has not got), its own hair styles first (every other style follows) and its mark in the skin (trait: people_trait.gdshaderinc). Names are placeholders until a collision check (docs/peoples_world.md). Our own designs: no names, symbols or designs from Treasure Planet, The Edge Chronicles or Fullmetal Alchemist.

peoples.label: Downbelowers
peoples.emblem: A pine over a hearth's three logs
peoples.note: The ground folk of the Downbelow: farms, forts and trappers' cabins under the Drift, muskets and homespun. Most have never seen the Sway; a few children are Sighted. Every face and skin of the world is here.

peoples.label: Driftborn
peoples.emblem: A sail filled by a spiral of wind
peoples.note: Born for generations on the floating isles and the ships of the Drift: tall and lean, weathered by the high wind, with pale eyes that squint at the ground's dull light. Natural windcallers: most sky crews, traders and pirates are Driftborn.

peoples.label: Keelfolk
peoples.emblem: A keelstone crystal on a miner's pick
peoples.note: Miners of keelstone in the roots of the floating isles: stocky and broad, at home in the dark under the Drift. A life in keelstone dust leaves fine crystal flecks in the skin that catch the light, and glow faintly when they use the Sway.

trait.label: Keelstone flecks
trait.note: Fine keelstone crystal in the skin from the mines: it catches the light, and glows faintly.

peoples.label: The Etched
peoples.emblem: A circle drawn round a stepped pyramid
peoples.note: The Form-workers of Vessary's pyramids: scholars, builders and rulers. Years of drawing Form through the body leave its paths in the skin, fine veins that glow as they cast.

trait.label: Form veins
trait.note: The paths Form has worn through the body: fine veins that glow.
